1) **One drawing sheet:** Yes, the diagram is contained within a single, large rectangular frame (the light gray canvas area).
2) **Key equipment visible:** Yes. The tall distillation column (T-101) with horizontal tray lines is central; the feed sphere (F-101) and preheater (E-101) are on the left; the condenser (E-102) and reflux drum (V-101) are at the top right; and the reboiler (E-103) is at the bottom right.
3) **Stream lines:** Yes. Numbered stream pills (1 through 9) are clearly visible on the connecting lines, and they do not overlap with the equipment symbols or their labels.
4) **Title block:** Yes, there is a title block in the upper right of the drawing area. The text "BENZENE-TOLUENE DISTILLATION · PFD", "SHEET 1 OF 1", and "REV A" is fully readable.
5) **Visual glitches:** No. The layout is clean with no overlapping text, clipped elements, or missing pieces. All components are well-spaced and legible.
